name: source-initialization-profiling
goal: Record actual completed initialization of registered data modules through Harness without substituting initialization for callable work or inventing failed/type-only profiles.

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: Source runners cover declared callables but cannot time data/schema initialization at module scope without wrapping exports in a function. Existing profiler has no completion-scope API. Actual registered data import currently emits no measurements.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: Add standard profiler scope cases for actual elapsed work, idempotent finish, unfinished and invalid subjects. Extend normal runner tests with actual data initialization, failed imports and type-only source; preserve existing callable/generator cases.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Committed14a71502 redde3d4bb2: two actual profiler cases fail because beginScope is absent; the registered data import also lacks its two observations. Five boundary cases already pass.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Add idempotent completed scopes to the existing profiler and admit only inspected data initializers in the adapter. Skip callable definitions, helper contracts and profiler bootstrap dependencies; failed scopes never reach finish.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: 21 focused cases pass; eight scope/runner cases rerun unchanged after lint extraction. Types, lint, audit, registry, API declarations/build and two packed-consumer tests pass. Bootstrap profiles remain required via explicit workloads.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Paired red288aec6b at14a71502 and green67e50b91 at7c17c326 run unchanged scope and runner tests in one environment; eight cases pass and four actual source measurements are retained.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: The isolated pre-scope snapshot lacks beginScope and data-import observations; repaired source passes the same cases. Failed initialization and type-only modules remain unobserved, callable profiles are not replaced.

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
